headline: NIST publishes an AI incident-management workshop report and plans broader response guidance
summary: NIST published IR 8621 on 2 November, summarizing a May workshop on incidents involving highly capable AI systems. The report separates attacks against AI systems from harm caused by misuse, anomalous behavior or malfunction, and describes gaps in observability, evidence, containment and responsibility across AI supply chains. NIST says it plans to update SP 800-61 and develop or explore agent-incident guidance, monitoring/logging, information sharing and traceability resources. These are workshop findings and proposed future work, not binding requirements or evidence that controls are implemented or effective.
